CLAUDE.md — GiottoClass

Source: CLAUDE.md

Package Overview

GiottoClass is the foundational S4 object framework for the Giotto Suite of spatial omics analysis tools. It defines the giotto object and all its subobjects, data access methods, and basic object creation utilities. Other packages in the suite (GiottoVisuals, GiottoAnalysis, etc.) build on top of the classes defined here.

  • Package version: 0.5.0
  • R requirement: >= 4.5.0
  • Primary spatial backend: terra (SpatVector / SpatRaster)

Repository Structure

R/                        # All source code (~79 files, ~57k lines)
tests/testthat/           # testthat Edition 3 tests (24 files)
man/                      # Roxygen2-generated .Rd files (never edit manually)
vignettes/                # Package vignettes (knitr)
.github/workflows/        # CI/CD (staging, dev, feature branch workflows)
DESCRIPTION               # Package metadata and dependencies
NAMESPACE                 # Generated by roxygen2 — never edit manually
NEWS.md                   # Changelog

Key R Files

File Role
R/classes.R Core giotto S4 class definition (22 slots)
R/classes-virtuals.R Virtual/abstract base classes
R/classes-points.R giottoPoints, featureNetwork
R/classes-polygons.R giottoPolygon
R/classes-images.R giottoImage, giottoLargeImage, giottoAffineImage
R/classes-overlaps.R Overlap relationship classes
R/classes-binpoints.R giottoBinPoints
R/generics.R All S4 generic definitions (~38 generics)
R/methods-*.R Method implementations (45 files, one per operation)
R/slot_accessors.R get*()/set*() functions for giotto slots (6,400+ lines)
R/create.R Primary object creation functions
R/interoperability.R Seurat, AnnData, SpatialExperiment conversions
R/aggregate.R Feature aggregation (polygon × point overlaps → matrix)
R/subset.R Subsetting operations
R/generics.R S4 generic declarations
R/package_imports.R All @import/@importFrom declarations (centralised)
R/auxilliary.R Internal helper utilities
R/zzz.R Package startup hooks, allMatrix class union

S4 Class Hierarchy

giottoSubobject (virtual base)
├── exprData          → exprObj
├── coordDataDT       → spatLocsObj, cellMetaObj, featMetaObj
├── spatData          → giottoPolygon, giottoPoints, giottoBinPoints
├── dimObj
├── spatialNetworkObj, spatialGridObj
├── spatEnrObj, nnNetObj
├── giottoImage, giottoLargeImage, giottoAffineImage
└── overlapPointDT, overlapIntensityDT

giotto (main object, 22 slots — lists of the above subobjects)

The giotto slot lists are keyed by spat_unit (spatial unit, e.g. "cell") and feat_type (feature type, e.g. "rna").

Development Workflow

# Standard devtools workflow
devtools::load_all()     # Load package for interactive development
devtools::document()     # Regenerate NAMESPACE + man/ from roxygen2
devtools::check()        # Full R CMD check
devtools::test()         # Run testthat suite

Do not edit NAMESPACE or files in man/ directly. All documentation and export declarations are managed through roxygen2 tags in R source files. Run devtools::document() after changing any @export, @importFrom, or @param tags.

Coding Conventions

Full style guide: https://giottosuite.com/articles/coding_style.html Dispatch functions: https://giottosuite.com/articles/dispatch_functions.html

Naming

Type Convention Example
Exported user-facing functions camelCase createGiottoObject()
S4 classes camelCase giottoLargeImage
Exported utility / non-user-facing snake_case dt_to_matrix()
Internal functions .snake_case (leading dot) .detect_in_dir()
Parameters / arguments snake_case spat_unit, feat_type

Do not use periods as name separators — this conflicts with S3 dispatch. Do not use non-UTF-8 characters; use Unicode escapes instead (e.g. \u00F6).

Other

  • Style: 4-space indentation, following BioConductor conventions (biocthis + styler). Enforced by lintr in CI.
  • S4 patterns:
    • Generic definitions go in R/generics.R with @rdname tags.
    • Method implementations go in the corresponding R/methods-<topic>.R file.
    • New slot types may need class union updates in R/zzz.R.
  • Imports: Add all @importFrom declarations to R/package_imports.R, not scattered across files.
  • Error handling: Use GiottoUtils helpers (gstop(), gwarn(), gmessage()) rather than bare stop()/warning().
  • Validation: Use checkmate for input validation at function boundaries.
  • Data tables: The package uses data.table throughout; prefer data.table idioms over base R for tabular operations.

Adding New Classes

  1. Define the class with setClass() in the appropriate R/classes-*.R file.
  2. Export it via @exportClass in its roxygen block.
  3. Define a constructor (e.g., createGiottoFoo()) in R/create.R.
  4. Add any required generics to R/generics.R.
  5. Add method implementations in a new or existing R/methods-*.R file.
  6. If the class needs to be stored inside a giotto object slot, update the slot type union in R/classes.R and R/zzz.R.
  7. Add a packed* variant if the class wraps a terra spatial object (needed for serialisation).
  8. Write tests in tests/testthat/.

Testing

# Run all tests
devtools::test()

# Run a specific file
testthat::test_file("tests/testthat/test_03_accessors.R")

Test data is loaded from the GiottoData package via helpers like GiottoData::loadGiottoMini() and GiottoData::loadSubObjectMini(). Global test setup lives in tests/testthat/setup.R, which sets:

options("giotto.use_conda" = FALSE)      # No conda during tests
options("giotto.no_python_warn" = TRUE)  # Suppress Python warnings
options("lifecycle_verbosity" = "quiet")

Tests are numbered (test_01_*.R … test_10_*.R) for ordered execution of foundational object creation, then named for functional areas.

Dependencies

Hard imports (always required): terra, data.table, Matrix, igraph, dbscan, deldir, checkmate, matrixStats, reticulate, GiottoUtils

Optional (Suggests): Seurat/SeuratObject, SingleCellExperiment, SpatialExperiment, sf, sp, stars, magick, HDF5Array, qs, and others — check DESCRIPTION for the full list.

When adding a new dependency: - Hard requirement → add to Imports: in DESCRIPTION and add @importFrom in R/package_imports.R. - Optional → add to Suggests: and guard usage with package_check("pkg", repository = "CRAN") (or "Bioc" / "github").

Branches and CI/CD

Branch Workflow Checks
staging staging_branch_workflow.yml R CMD check (macOS/Windows/Linux), codecov, BiocCheck
dev dev_branch_workflow.yml codecov, R CMD check, BiocCheck, lintr
feature branches feature_branch_workflow.yml codecov, R CMD check, BiocCheck, lintr
  • PRs should target dev; releases are cut from staging → main.
  • BiocCheck is run to ensure Bioconductor submission compatibility.
  • Code coverage is reported to codecov.

Interoperability

Conversion functions in R/interoperability.R cover:

From / To Function
Seurat v4/v5 → Giotto seuratToGiotto(), seuratToGiottoV4(), seuratToGiottoV5()
Giotto → Seurat giottoToSeurat(), giottoToSeuratV5()
AnnData → Giotto anndataToGiotto()
Giotto → AnnData giottoToAnnData()
SpatialExperiment ↔︎ Giotto spatialExperimentToGiotto(), giottoToSpatialExperiment()
SpatialData → Giotto spatialdataToGiotto()
